description:
Import an existing Android Gradle project into Android Studio. The project files are located at /home/ga/AndroidStudioProjects/SunflowerApp (already set up for you).

1. Open Android Studio and use 'Open' from the Welcome screen or File menu to open the project at ~/AndroidStudioProjects/SunflowerApp
2. If prompted to trust the project, click 'Trust Project'
3. Wait for Gradle sync to complete (watch the status bar at the bottom)
4. Once sync is complete, verify you can see the project structure in the Project panel with the app module and source files
